prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: game sprite animation atlas. Input image 1 is the approved Tunguska vehicle identity and camera reference. Generate a 1536x1024 RGBA transparent sprite sheet, exactly THREE columns by TWO rows of six 512x512 frames read left to right. Each cell contains the SAME vehicle centered at (256,256), vehicle about 360px high and230px wide, all effects and every part inside x56..456,y56..456. Camera EXACTLY vertical90-degree nadir orthographic overhead. Vehicle front points SCREEN BOTTOM. Match olive paint, dark steel tracks, hull grilles,hatches,turret,rear radar as thin edge at SCREEN TOP, FOUR long dark gun barrels in two pairs pointing downward, two banks of paired olive missile tubes alongside turret. Show roofs and tops only, NO front or side wall faces. Painted game art with restrained outlines, broad forms. Identical hull position size alignment geometry lighting in EVERY cell, no zoom perspective deformation. Motion: MISSILE LAUNCH. Frame0 ready. Frame1 selected outer SCREEN RIGHT olive missile canister opens its front at screen bottom. Frame2 ONE small narrow pale olive missile emerges from that SCREEN RIGHT tube towards SCREEN BOTTOM, compact orange exhaust behind missile. Frame3 same missile now just beyond tube end, all still inside the cell safety margin, very short orange rear exhaust aligned with tube axis. Frame4 missile gone and only tiny fading exhaust at selected tube. Frame5 ready with one used tube. The ONE missile launches from SCREEN RIGHT olive canister, NOT any dark gun barrel, NOT radar. NO gun muzzle flash in this animation. Maintain all four guns and other tubes throughout. Small launch effects preserve vehicle legibility. Truly transparent outside vehicle and effects; no smokecloud, scenery, ground, shadows, text,borders,guides.
CRITICAL CORRECTION TO ATTACHED SHEET: preserve exact vehicle and launch sequence, but recreate atlas with MUCH SMALLER sprites. Vehicle only360px tall. Six square512cells with sprite centers EXACTLY x256,768,1280 and y256,768. Each vehicle AND missile/effects fits central380x380px region leaving at least66px clear space ON EVERY SIDE of EACH cell. Uniform frame positions and spacing. Small sprites with generous transparent padding, not large vehicles filling cells.
